snippet.title: HOPE - Official Teaser - In Theaters Fall 2026
snippet.description: In the remote South Korea village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok (Hwang Jung- min) and officer Sung-ae (Hoyeon) are called to find a mysterious creature that has wreaked havoc on the village.  In the nearby forest, a coterie of hunters, including Sung- ki (Zo In-Sung) set out to track the beast and find themselves hunted instead. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

snippet.title: DEVIN TOWNSEND - Prepare for War · The Big Snit (OFFICIAL VIDEO)
snippet.description:
"This is a track that essentially acts as a ‘soundtrack for an unmade movie’ …if you think of it as a ‘song’ its not really going to work, but if you think of it as a cinematic ‘experience’ that is representative of the final moments before a ‘fundamental change’ it’s a cool adventure.

Either viewed from the lens of the ‘war’ being that of two warring factions whose actions have culminated in a ‘final battle’, or the same thing being essentially a metaphor for an internal struggle, it works in the sam light. The battle itself can be representative of a decision, loss, change, or whatever. But sitting with the difficulty of life and our natures can often be violent work, so ‘the fastest way out is through’ and this piece of music represents that process. The ending is meant to be a representation of a sort of personal awakening.

The name ‘the big snit’ was taken from a short cartoon from the Canadian national film board by the same name I grew up with. If you get a chance, look it up on YouTube … I guess my version here is simply a kind of heavy metal version of that :)." Dev

‘The Moth’ out on 29th May 2026 via InsideOutMusic.

Pre-order and stream here: https://dvn.lnk.to/TheMoth
Devin's official Omerch store: https://devintownsend.omerch.com/

Tell a little secret about her
We ride while the wind is cold
It’s over: divide.

Little bee
Little bee
’Cause indeed every time, old deadeye.
荒唐
荒唐
荒唐
摧毁这些声音 现在
相信自己 尽情释放吧

Show us all

NEVER WALK AWAY

Watch the 'FAN (CONCEPT) Trailer Concept' For Star Wars The Mandalorian And Grogu (2026)  (More Info About This Video Down Below!)

Experience the galaxy like never before in this epic concept trailer for The Mandalorian and Grogu, the highly anticipated feature film directed by Jon Favreau and written alongside Dave Filoni. Set after the events of The Mandalorian Season 3, the story follows Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) and his apprentice, Grogu, as they transition from the small screen to the grand stage of global cinema. Following the fall of the Galactic Empire, the fledgling New Republic enlists our favorite duo for a high-stakes mission: rescuing Rotta the Hutt—voiced by Jeremy Allen White—in exchange for critical intelligence on a rising Imperial threat. As the bond between "Mando" and his ward deepens, they must navigate a galaxy where Imperial warlords still lurk in the shadows and alliances are as fragile as Beskar is strong.

This cinematic journey features a star-studded cast, including legendary actress Sigourney Weaver as Colonel Ward, a veteran New Republic leader and ace pilot who shares a deep history with Leia Organa. Fans will also be thrilled by the return of fan-favorites like Garazeb "Zeb" Orrelios (voiced by Steve Blum) and unexpected cameos, including a brief appearance by filmmaker Martin Scorsese as an Ardennian shopkeeper. With an immersive score by Oscar-winner Ludwig Göransson and breathtaking visuals that bring the Outer Rim to life, The Mandalorian and Grogu promises to be a definitive chapter in the Star Wars saga. This trailer explores the "What If" scenarios and high-octane action expected when the film officially hits theaters on May 22, 2026. This is the way!

Trailer mashups are not just a form of user-generated digital creativity but also a unique way to build excitement for upcoming releases, complementing official movie trailers. While traditional trailers tease the plot and generate hype, fan-made mashups let the audience put their own cinematic twist on existing footage. This creative freedom can spotlight a particular actor, emphasize a specific storyline, or even transform the film’s genre entirely.

[Intro: Flo Rida]
You're a troublemaker, you're a troublemaker

Troublemaker

It's like you're always there in the corners of my mind

Warner Bros. Games provided early access for review – all opinions are my own.

What’s going on everybody and welcome to Part 1 of my full LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight gameplay walkthrough on PS5! Today we begin the brand-new open-world LEGO Batman adventure from TT Games and WB Games with the emotional Batman Begins-inspired opening story featuring young Bruce Wayne, Crime Alley, the League of Shadows, Ra’s al Ghul, Talia al Ghul, and the very first major boss fight in the game!

A HUGE thank you to Warner Bros. Games for providing me with an early review copy of LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight. Full disclosure and massive appreciation to them for the opportunity!

This first episode features:
Young Bruce Wayne gameplay at Wayne Manor
Monarch Theater sequence
The tragic Crime Alley origin story
Iceberg Lounge Falcone fight
League of Shadows training
Nanda Parbat gameplay
Ra’s al Ghul boss battle
Talia al Ghul scenes
Batman Begins references and Easter eggs
New free-flow Arkham-style combat
Focus meter takedowns
Stealth gameplay mechanics
Grapple traversal and platforming
Batarangs and shuriken combat
Purple studs and collectibles
Red power bricks
Full live commentary and reactions

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight looks absolutely incredible so far. The atmosphere, Gotham City visuals, combat upgrades, character animations, and deep Batman references already make this feel like one of the most ambitious LEGO games ever made. 🌆 Open World Gotham – Explore famous locations like Ace Chemicals, Wayne Tower, Arkham Asylum, and Gotham Botanical Gardens.
🦇 Playable Heroes – Batman, Jim Gordon, Robin, Nightwing, Batgirl, Catwoman, and Talia al Ghul, each with unique gadgets and combat styles.
😈 Classic Villains – The Joker, Penguin, Poison Ivy, Ra’s al Ghul, Bane, and more.
🚗 Vehicles – Drive legendary Batmobiles and Batcycles.
🎮 Gameplay – New combat system with fluid combos, takedowns, and gadget-based action.
👥 Co-Op – Two-player local couch co-op (no online co-op).
💰 No Microtransactions – 100% complete experience with no in-game purchases.
✨ Bonus Suit – Unlock the Golden Age Batsuit (Detective Comics #27, 1939) by signing up for a free WB Games account.

Platforms: PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2, and PC (Steam & Epic Games Store).
Price/Pre-Order: Not available yet, but wishlisting is open now.

ABOUT NO BACKUP:
You’re part of a special ops team. Armed with your bodycam, weapon and a radio, you’re sent into an abandoned zone. The mission: get out alive, together.
But something is hunting you. Silent. Relentless. One wrong move, and it’s over.
Team up with up to three friends in intense co-op gameplay.
You’ll need to stick together, cover each other, and plan every move - or you won’t make it out alive.
Use in-game voice chat to coordinate, but choose your words wisely: the monster hears you.
Panic, split up, or hesitate for even a second and someone won’t come back.
See what your character sees. The entire game is viewed through a shaky, immersive bodycam with no health bars. The limited field of view and unstable movement create a disturbing sense of realism.
You’re not watching a horror movie.
You’re in one.

(ignore tags LOL)
I played in a Minecraft SMP, or survival multiplayer server similar to SMP Earth, Dream SMP, or Lifesteal SMP (lifesteal smp season 2). Survival and PVP Minecraft content inspired by TommyInnit, Dream, Technoblade, Clownpierce, Rekrap2, Grian, and other Minecraft content creators. This a whitelisted lifesteal server.

In this minecraft video, I became IMMORTAL on this LIFESTEAL SMP. I did this on a copy of the Lifesteal SMP, also known as the deadliest minecraft server to exist, and it was super intense. The Lifesteal SMP features creators such as ClownPierce, PrinceZam, Leowook, Parrot, Spoke, roshambo, and more. This server also contains people like Parrot (also known as ParrotX2 or zParrot) and Spoke (also known as SpokeIsHere). This is similar to Parrot or ParrotX2 on the school SMP series where he started a war or ended a war or when Spoke Created 1000+ Iron Golems to Kill 1 Player in Survival Minecraft. This is also similar to how Spoke Broke 38 rules on this Minecraft SMP, or when he created an Illegal Minecraft Farm or an Illegal Minecraft Vault. 

Like ParrotX2 videos and the LifeSteal SMP, a Minecraft Server Not like Dream SMP or Tommyinnit or Technoblade or any other Dream SMP members. This SMP is like LifeStealSMP and OneTrySMP, this is the hardest Minecraft Sever ever! and it is also a lore-based server in the MCYT community. I hope you enjoy this video, a true Minecraft hardcore server. Not only that, this server has the elements of school SMP and lifesteal SMP, but everything is Hardcore. This is a Hardcore SMP server

Like ParrotX2 and his Unstable Universe series where he broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prisons or got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players. This is a new and original Minecraft idea like HermitCraft, Unstable SMP or Lifesteal with rekrap2, wemmbu, Spoke, Grian or MumboJumbo. Survival is harder than Hardcore Minecraft because PVP is on. 

I got OP god weapons the deadliest weapons in Minecraft on a deadly hardcore Minecraft server public minecraft smp god weapons deadly weapons god armor, god mace, god spear, god sword, will I succeed or get banned? idk. if you're reading this though, subscribe!

snippet.title: DF Direct Weekly #264: PS5 Path Tracing Tested, FSR 4.1 For RDNA 2/3, 007 First Light Hits 60FPS!
snippet.description:
Thanks to Alienware for sponsoring DF Direct. To learn more about the Alienware AREA-51 Gaming Desktop, check out: http://aw.gg/digitalfoundry

PS5 Linux continues to yield dividends as Rich tests path tracing on PS5 with Quake 2 RTX, Portal RTX and Cyberpunk 2077 RT Overdrive (!) on Sony's console. Beyond that, there's great news with the announcement of FSR 4.1 coming to older Radeon graphics cards, and there's a hint that Xbox may have some kind of "disc to digital" way to bring your physical purchases over to a potentially disc-less Project Helix. There’s no shortage of things to love about  Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight. It’s an excellent Batman game that has everything in place to keep fans satisfied while we wait for our next big AAA Dark Knight adventure, a solid (yet simplified) take on the beloved Arkham formula, and of course, yet another charming, amusing, and addictive LEGO adventure by TT Games. 

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight might not be the Batman game we deserve, but it’s the one we need.

snippet.title: Could The 2026 UK Navy Have Beaten The 1982 UK Navy? | Sea Power
snippet.description:
Can a modern Royal Navy task force defeat the massed strength of the Cold War fleet? In this Sea Power naval warfare simulation, we pit the 2026 Royal Navy against its 1982 equivalent in an epic destroyer and frigate battle.

Thirteen modern Type 45 destroyers and Type 23 frigates face overwhelming numbers from the Cold War era: fifty three County-class and Type 42 destroyers alongside Type 22, Type 21, Leander, and Rothesay frigates.

The 2026 fleet attacks with sixty four Naval Strike Missiles (NSM) and defends using advanced Aster and CAMM air defence systems. Meanwhile, the 1982 Royal Navy counters with MM38 Exocet anti-ship missiles backed by Sea Dart, Sea Wolf, Sea Cat, and Sea Slug missile systems.

Will modern technology and missile defence overcome sheer numbers, or does quantity still win at sea? Watch this Sea Power simulation to find out.

Featuring:
Type 45 destroyers
Type 23 frigates
County-class destroyers
Type 42 destroyers
Leander-class frigates
Naval Strike Missile (NSM)
Exocet missile combat
Aster and CAMM air defence
Cold War naval warfare

Mods:

localized.title: Could The 2026 UK Navy Have Beaten The 1982 UK Navy? | Sea Power
localized.description:
Can a modern Royal Navy task force defeat the massed strength of the Cold War fleet? In this Sea Power naval warfare simulation, we pit the 2026 Royal Navy against its 1982 equivalent in an epic destroyer and frigate battle.

Thirteen modern Type 45 destroyers and Type 23 frigates face overwhelming numbers from the Cold War era: fifty three County-class and Type 42 destroyers alongside Type 22, Type 21, Leander, and Rothesay frigates.

The 2026 fleet attacks with sixty four Naval Strike Missiles (NSM) and defends using advanced Aster and CAMM air defence systems. Meanwhile, the 1982 Royal Navy counters with MM38 Exocet anti-ship missiles backed by Sea Dart, Sea Wolf, Sea Cat, and Sea Slug missile systems.

Will modern technology and missile defence overcome sheer numbers, or does quantity still win at sea? Watch this Sea Power simulation to find out.

Featuring:
Type 45 destroyers
Type 23 frigates
County-class destroyers
Type 42 destroyers
Leander-class frigates
Naval Strike Missile (NSM)
Exocet missile combat
Aster and CAMM air defence
Cold War naval warfare
